note: Every Accumulation hit uses its preceding 60 sessions as three consecutive 20-session chunks. Each chunk is classified independently; the latest chunk is the current shape, and the saved path preserves the preceding two chunks. A Golden Flat requires both a near-zero center slope and near-zero curvature in that latest 20-session chunk. Thresholds are normalized by the window mean close and calibrated so the BHEL reference window ending 2026-03-30 is a valid downward drift.
